comments.body: Remote work reduces commuting time and makes flexible scheduling possible. Distributed teams need clear documentation and regular planning.

replies.body: New employees benefit from mentoring sessions and structured onboarding. Video calls help remote colleagues build relationships.

comments.body: Our laptops need more memory to run local containers. Better battery life would help developers working away from an outlet.
The city should increase bus frequency and build protected bicycle lanes. Reliable transport reduces the cost of commuting.
